posts.body: Hi, I'm encountering some problems with my game, when my actor uses a skill (a sword skill), the weapon motion doesn't appear and instead he uses the magic stance (see image). posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
@SGHarlekin
is correct, however, just going off of your description, this is the expected behavior. Without using a plugin like Action Sequences, you will
never
see a weapon used for anything except the default Attack skill.
If the skill type is listed under Magic, you will see the Magic motion; otherwise you will see the General Skill motion (which is what you show in your screenshot).

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: If you want to use weapon motions for special skills, but action sequences are overkill for you, I recommend DreamX_SkillMotion.
